decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by a mix of combat tricks and protection spells to push through damage and overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Tenth District Legionnaire and Monastery Swiftspear, and then use spells like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage to clear a path for attacks. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility and power to the deck.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and deal damage to the opponent. It includes a mix of cheap spells and cantrips to generate value and fuel the Phoenix's recursion. Key cards include Lightning Axe for removal, Treasure Cruise for card draw, and Picklock Prankster for additional graveyard interaction. The deck aims to be aggressive and control the board while steadily bringing back the Phoenix to pressure the opponent. It also includes a few counter spells and versatile cards for added flexibility.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix and overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive creatures. The deck includes cards like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise to help draw through the deck, while also utilizing cheap spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Spell Pierce helps to provide additional disruption and protection, allowing the deck to maintain tempo and pressure its opponent effectively.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal, and card draw. It aims to control the board with cards like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Dovin's Veto. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility. The deck also includes various utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale to further control the game. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through careful resource management and powerful control elements.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly getting Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and then reanimating it multiple times throughout the game to deal consistent damage to the opponent. Key cards like Opt, Consider, and Treasure Cruise help dig through the deck to find the Phoenix, while cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe help remove threats from the opponent's side of the board. The deck also includes some interaction with counterspells like Spell Pierce to protect the Phoenix once it's in play, and Prismari Command for additional removal and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells and counter magic, while also using powerful creatures such as Elder Deep-Fiend and Flamewake Phoenix to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, clear the board when necessary, and finish the game with efficient threats. The mana base is optimized to support this strategy and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors for spells and creatures. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control and outpacing the opponent in order to secure victory.

The main idea behind this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. Using a combination of powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, Bonecrusher Giant, and Reckoner Bankbuster, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to apply constant pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With a mix of hasty creatures, targeted removal, and hand disruption, this deck looks to establish board control early and maintain it throughout the game to secure a quick victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on strategic play and disruption to control the game. It utilizes counterspells like Dovin's Veto and removal spells like Temporary Lockdown and No More Lies to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card advantage tools like Memory Deluge and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to maintain control of the board. With the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad providing extra value, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through careful planning and resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Boros creatures like Knight-Errant of Eos, Venerated Loxodon, and Warden of the Inner Sky to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. Supporting cards like Thraben Inspector and Novice Inspector provide card advantage and early game presence, while cards like Imodane's Recruiter and Resolute Reinforcements help maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base includes fast lands like Battlefield Forge and Inspiring Vantage to ensure smooth mana development. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and win through a fast-paced aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field as a key piece in a combo strategy, ramping up mana quickly with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Sylvan Scrying. By using cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, the deck can effectively untap Lotus Field multiple times in a turn to generate massive amounts of mana. With the help of cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience, the deck can quickly win the game by casting powerful spells like Dragonlord Dromoka or Atraxa, Grand Unifier. Overall, the deck aims to create explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and putting pressure on opponents through efficient creatures and combat tricks. Utilizing powerful cards like Embercleave and The Huntsman's Redemption, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents early on and maintain a consistent aggressive strategy throughout the game. With a mix of creatures with haste, trample, and direct damage abilities, the deck can quickly close out games before opponents have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the deck includes some utility lands to provide additional advantages in certain situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and then bring them back to the battlefield for quick and aggressive attacks. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells to ensure a consistent stream of cheap spells to trigger the Phoenix's ability. Additionally, there are some control elements such as Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to deal with opposing threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient game plan centered around the powerful Arclight Phoenix.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Arclight Phoenix as a powerful recurring threat while also enabling card draw and disruption through cheap spells like Lightning Axe, Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise. Ledger Shredder helps to enable the Phoenix's graveyard recursion ability, while cards like Picklock Prankster and Fiery Impulse provide additional aggro pressure and removal. With a mix of tempo plays and burn spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 setting.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cheap spells to enable the recurring ability of Arclight Phoenix. By using efficient cantrips and burn spells, the deck aims to dig through the library, generate card advantage, and bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times in a single turn. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and efficient removal like Lightning Axe allows the deck to handle opposing threats while maintaining a fast-paced aggressive strategy. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful late-game threat, complementing the deck's overall game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful life gain engine using cards like Wildgrowth Walker, Prosperous Innkeeper, and Gilded Goose, while also utilizing Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key combo pieces like Amalia Benavides Aguirre. The addition of cards like Lunarch Veteran, Voice of Resurgence, and Sentinel of the Nameless City provides support and protection for the combo, allowing the player to gain a significant advantage in the mid to late game. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a strong board presence and resilient creatures.

The deck focuses on generating life gain and creating a wide board presence with creatures to support the combo win condition of Aetherflux Reservoir. Amalia Benavides Aguirre is a key piece in the deck, providing additional life gain and support for the combo strategy. The deck also includes several creature tutors like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to help find key pieces quickly. Additionally, the deck includes some control elements like Skyclave Apparition and Boseiju, Who Endures to deal with opposing threats and protect the combo.
